title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
summary: The migration, rollout windows and documented commands are supported. The statement that Microsoft has not identified an administrative role needs correcting: Microsoft documents both Teams Administrator and Teams Communications Administrator as able to manage meeting policies.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: MeetingAI controls the availability of Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap and other AI features in meetings.
claims.quote: MeetingAI - controls whether Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap, and other AI features are available in meetings.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; controls[1]
claims.claim: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.claim: The current Copilot policy combines AI availability and whether a saved transcript is required.
claims.quote: Today, the Copilot policy combines whether AI is available in a meeting with whether a saved transcript is required.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The replacement policy model includes the ability to enforce Copilot off.
claims.quote: including the ability to enforce Copilot off.

claims.claim: Microsoft automatically maps existing Copilot values once, preserving current effective behaviour.
claims.quote: Microsoft will perform a one-time update mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values, preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators do not need to recreate policies or act to migrate existing configurations.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations.

claims.claim: The policy replacement arrives automatically and applies mapped existing configurations without an administrator opting in.
claims.quote: Existing configurations will be mapped automatically.

claims.claim: The notice places the planned new settings in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.
claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.

claims.quote: The Transcription policy remains available and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Who can use AI gives organisers finer control over which participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.claim: Start Transcription with AI is an organiser option that administrators can also control through Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI. Administrators can also control this option through Teams admin center.

claims.claim: Organisers gain Intelligent Recap controls, including for meetings without a created transcript.
claims.quote: Intelligent Recap controls - lets organizers decide whether an Intelligent Recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including for meetings where a transcript is not created.

claims.claim: Once the new controls are enabled, direct updates to the Copilot policy stop working and return guidance to use the replacement policies.
claims.quote: Once the new controls are enabled, the Copilot policy can no longer be updated directly - attempts will return guidance to use the new policies.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the policy change does not alter processing or storage of existing customer data.
claims.quote: This change affects administrative controls over AI and transcription availability in meetings but does not alter how existing customer data is processed or stored.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance

claims.quote: Review any automation or scripts that read or update the Copilot meeting policy, and update them to use MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.

claims.claim: Teams meeting policies govern users and can be assigned to groups or individual users.
claims.quote: You can apply your Copilot meeting policies to groups or individual users.

claims.claim: Copilot in Teams meetings and events is unavailable in end-to-end encrypted meetings.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events isn't available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.

claims.quote:

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default.
claims.quote: Work IQ access is also off by default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said which administrator role can edit the new meeting policies.
claims.quote: Teams Communications Administrator | Manage calling and meetings features within the Teams service. | Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.
claims.fix: Replace the unqualified role-absence statement and matching open question with: 'Microsoft documents Teams Administrator and Teams Communications Administrator as able to manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and PowerShell; no separate role requirement is stated for these new parameters.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/using-admin-roles.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

## Prerequisites

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI license pricing; "MeetingAI" "license" "TranscriptionWithMeetingAI". Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-teams-transcription; neither gives a separate licence requirement for the new parameters.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate meter for the new policy settings.
claims.quote: Searched: "TranscriptionWithMeetingAI" "pricing" meter license; Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI license pricing metering. Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-teams-transcription; neither documents a meter for these parameters.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap record nor the supplied notice mentions a charge.
claims.quote: Searched: "TranscriptionWithMeetingAI" "pricing" meter license. Read the full supplied roadmap record and MC1532253, including Action Required/Recommendations and Compliance considerations; neither states a charge.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet document an admin-centre navigation path for MeetingAI; the notice describes a future setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings Start transcription policy; "MeetingAI" "Teams admin center". Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-teams-transcription; no MeetingAI UI path is given.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy accepts Identity and MeetingAI with EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride, DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride or DisabledNoOverride, together with TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote:
This parameter must be used together with -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.

Possible values are:

- EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledNoOverride

claims.claim: Learn does not yet document an admin-centre navigation path for TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings Start transcription policy. Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-teams-transcription; no TranscriptionWithMeetingAI UI path is given.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy accepts Identity and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI with EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride, DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride or EnabledNoOverride, together with MeetingAI.
claims.quote:
This parameter must be used together with -MeetingAI.

Possible values are:

- EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride
- EnabledNoOverride

claims.claim: The existing Copilot setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote:
go to **Meetings** > **Meeting policies**.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.
3. Go to the **Recording & transcription** section and find the **Copilot** setting.

claims.claim: The current Copilot guidance documents Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity with Copilot values Enabled, EnabledWithTranscript, EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn and Disabled.
claims.quote:
| On | Enabled |
| On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript |
| On with transcript saved by default | EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn |
| Off | Disabled |

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference lists only Enabled and EnabledWithTranscript for Copilot, unlike the four-value product guidance.
claims.quote:
### -Copilot

This setting allows the admin to choose whether Copilot will be enabled with a persisted transcript or a non-persisted transcript.

Possible values are:

- Enabled
- EnabledWithTranscript

claims.claim: The existing transcription policy is managed in Recording & transcription in a Teams meeting policy.
claims.quote: You can use the **Recording & Transcription** section in the Teams admin center or the **`-AllowTranscription`** parameter in the **CsTeamsMeetingPolicy** PowerShell cmdlet to manage your transcription policy.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity -AllowTranscription accepts true to allow and false to prohibit transcription.
claims.quote:
### -AllowTranscription

Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: No admin UI path is documented for the AllowIntelligentRecap policy switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowIntelligentRecap turn off Teams admin center policy UI. Opened intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; disabling recap is documented through PowerShell, not a UI path.

claims.where: controls[4].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The product guidance documents Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false to disable intelligent recap.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference says AllowIntelligentRecap is not fully released and has no effect, in disagreement with the product guidance.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. Controls whether Intelligent Recap is allowed for the user's meetings.

claims.claim: The product guidance says disabling recap applies to meetings with and without saved transcripts and makes related settings unavailable.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved, and the related settings are unavailable in Teams.

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to **Meetings** > **Meeting settings**. Under **Transcript API access**, turn the **WorkIQ access** toggle **On**.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables the Work IQ transcript-access gate.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: The Work IQ transcript-access control is tenant scoped.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses the setting of the organization that organized the meeting, not the setting of the app's organization or of the user the app acts for.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: The supplied notice names no administrator control over Who can use AI.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI and Who can use AI are meeting options rather than separately described administrator policy switches.
claims.quote: Meeting options are also being updated to make AI controls easier to understand and to provide more granular control over who can enable, manage, and use AI capabilities

claims.claim: The supplied material describes no change to identity, permissions or administrative roles caused by this policy migration.
claims.quote: Searched: "MeetingAI" "role" administrator. Read MC1532253, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy, copilot-teams-transcription and using-admin-roles; no change to administrative roles or identity permissions for this migration is described.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not detailed the interaction between AllowIntelligentRecap and MeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: "AllowIntelligentRecap" "MeetingAI". Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts, and read MC1532253; they describe individual controls but not their combined precedence.

claims.claim: The supplied sources do not specify a tenant enablement signal or whether retirement of Copilot updates happens per tenant or per policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings Start transcription policy. Read MC1532253, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-teams-transcription; no enablement signal or retirement granularity is specified.

claims.claim: Microsoft has already moved the rollout dates.
claims.quote: Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The sources do not detail MeetingAI's coverage of post-meeting experiences beyond the roadmap description.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center Allow AI meetings Start transcription policy. Read roadmap, MC1532253 and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no comprehensive post-meeting scope for MeetingAI is specified.
